title: Lionel Messi: The Making of a Football Legend
description:
Lionel Messi is the most decorated player in football history. In a limited sample of StatsBomb event data (12 Barcelona league starts in 2009/10 and 12 in 2018/19), his shooting barely changed, while his key passes per 90 minutes rose from 1.4 to 3.5. Career facts from Wikipedia; photographs from Wikimedia Commons with credits in the video.
